race.description: BMWCA Local Legends Country Stampede Qualifier Quality Open Hcp
race.comment: LUNAR EIGHT (9) is the top pick after missing by a nose in Class 4 company at Sunshine Coast on soft ground, where she travelled well and was only caught on the post by Shako. That reads strongly for this, and her record at around 1030m gives the profile enough substance to trust on the quick back-up. MANHATTAN THUNDER (12) brings winning form, having scored in a BM60 at Tara after a close Taroom second, and the weight relief gives him a genuine chance to hold that level again. GITALONG (2) comes through a BM70 second at Toowoomba, beaten just over a length by Thundering Soul at big odds, and his broader distance record says this trip is no issue despite one flat run at Moree two back. MISSISSIPPI MORN (1) has won both runs this campaign at Emerald and owns an outstanding sprint record, with the rise from picnic grade the main factor he has to absorb.
